tools.description: Creates a namespace, which holds schemas and instances of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself. Its name is lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.

mcp.hiddenReason: the access policy refuses reader manage (archive) of namespaces

tools.description: Archives a namespace a create made: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, and it refuses every write, and runs no reaction or schedule, until it is unarchived.

tools.name: engine.unarchiveNamespace

mcp.hiddenReason: the access policy refuses reader manage (unarchive) of namespaces

data.name: projects
data.description: A project an engine runs with the core's behaviors and no extension: it moves from active to done or dropped, and rolls up the tasks that point at it through their project link: how many there are, how many are in each status, and whether every one is in a terminal state, which it needs before it is done.

instanceBehaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

status.description: The state the instance is in.

enteredAt.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

values.description: Each rollup's value, by name, computed when the instance is read: a count, counts by value, a number, a field's value, or a boolean. A rollup whose link holds more than 500 instances is {"over": true} instead; a min or max with no value to compare, and a latest whose instance holds none, is absent.

behaviors.name: Workflow
behaviors.description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.
behaviors.summary: Its status is one of active, done and dropped; a new Project starts in active, and status moves only by transition. Terminal, with their outcomes: done (success) and dropped (success).

fields.name: status
fields.description: The state the instance is in.

fields.name: enteredAt
fields.description: When the status last changed, in epoch milliseconds: the create's time, then each transition's. Absent on an instance created before Workflow kept it, until its next transition.

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
No transition of the config leads from the instance's state to the one named.
The instance has no status to move from.

behaviors.name: Rollups
behaviors.description: Values derived from the instances that point at this one through a link of their schema's Links config: how many there are, how many hold each value of a field, the sum, least or greatest of a numeric field, a field's value on the one created last, and whether every one or some one is in a terminal state of its schema's Workflow, optionally one with a listed outcome. A value is computed when the instance is read, as the caller, from at most 500 linked instances; a rollup over more has none. A rollup of every or some one may gate states of the type's Workflow: a transition into one waits until the rollup holds.
behaviors.summary: behaviors.Rollups.values holds values computed from linked instances at each read: tasks, how many of the tasks instances whose project points here there are; tasksByStatus, how many of the tasks instances whose project points here hold each value of Workflow.status; tasksFinished, whether every one of the tasks instances whose project points here is in a terminal state. A rollup over more than 500 linked instances reads {"over": true}. A move into done waits until tasksFinished holds.

fields.name: values
fields.description: Each rollup's value, by name, computed when the instance is read: a count, counts by value, a number, a field's value, or a boolean. A rollup whose link holds more than 500 instances is {"over": true} instead; a min or max with no value to compare, and a latest whose instance holds none, is absent.

vetoes.description: A Workflow transition into a state an all or any rollup gates while the rollup does not hold, or has no value past 500 linked instances; details names the rollup and counts the linked instances.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

anyOf.description: The state the instance is in.

items.description: The state the instance is in.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

guidance.useWhen: Use to page through Project instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title or Workflow.status; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's. where: { "Workflow.status": <state> } lists the instances in one of active, done or dropped, and a list of states the instances in any of them.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
guidance.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update projects
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the projects with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Project

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Project with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete projects
operations.description: Deletes the projects with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Project with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: projects: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from active to done or dropped.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from done or dropped: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is. Read behaviors.Rollups.values before a move: a move into done waits until tasksFinished holds.
guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move.

errors.description: Workflow: No transition leads from the instance's status to the state named; details.allowed lists the states it can move to.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status, then name a state details.allowed lists, or move through one of them first.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
errors.commonCorrection: Read status: the instance is already there, so nothing needs to move.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the work has ended. Create a new instance to start again.

errors.description: Workflow: The instance has no status to move from.
errors.commonCorrection: None: an instance without a status cannot move.

errors.description: Rollups: A move into a state a rollup gates while the rollup does not hold; details names the rollup and counts the linked instances it read and counted.
errors.commonCorrection: Read behaviors.Rollups.values, and finish the linked work the rollup waits on, then try again.

body.title: Conflict
body.detail: behavior Rollups vetoes transition of projects launch: projects launch cannot move to done until rollup tasksFinished holds: 1 of the 1 instances of tasks that point at it through project are not in a terminal state

details.reason: projects launch cannot move to done until rollup tasksFinished holds: 1 of the 1 instances of tasks that point at it through project are not in a terminal state
